//: Challenge profiles (docs/gameplay-overhaul/07-challenge-outcomes.md): shared rules a step opts into with "challenge": "<id>" (or { "profile": "<id>", ...overrides }). No story chapter uses any of them yet: every existing step is legacy and plays as it always has.

repair_graded.//: Can't fail (legacy assists stay on); reports how clean the work was. For quiet beats that should still be scored.

repair_strict.//: A real test: no widening, two fumbles allowed. Must be won to go on (unlimited retries from the checkpoint).

repair_hard_choice.//: Three tries against the clock; after any failure the captain may carry on with the damage instead (a chapter adds the consequences).

shark_duty_strict.//: A watch that can be lost: more than three bites, or two at one section. Retry from the start of the watch.

sash_trial_strict.//: The trial for real: lose the grip (three slips) or tear the sash and the ceremony is broken; held to the cue and let go on purpose, it's a success.

sash_deliberate_flutter.//: The captain WANTS it to flutter early (to trigger the Stenchmaster's consequences): letting go on purpose is success, though the ceremony calls it a violation; an accidental flutter is partial; holding to the end is a failure.
